cmd:
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openssh-client
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
TUNNEL_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aividup-tunnel.XXXXXXXX)
chmod 0700 "$TUNNEL_DIR"
printf '%s' "$AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_PRIVATE_KEY_B64" | base64 --decode > "$TUNNEL_DIR/id_ed25519"
chmod 0600 "$TUNNEL_DIR/id_ed25519"
printf '%s\n' "$AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_HOST_KEY" > "$TUNNEL_DIR/known_hosts"
chmod 0600 "$TUNNEL_DIR/known_hosts"
/usr/bin/ssh -N -L 127.0.0.1:18099:127.0.0.1:8099 -i "$TUNNEL_DIR/id_ed25519" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$TUNNEL_DIR/known_hosts" -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ServerAliveInterval=10 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 aividup-pilot-tunnel@195.234.126.233 &
TUNNEL_PID=$!
WORKER_PID=''
cleanup() { rc=$?; trap - EXIT INT TERM; if [ -n "$WORKER_PID" ]; then kill "$WORKER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$WORKER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; kill "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$TUNNEL_DIR"; exit "$rc"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 143' INT TERM
READY=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
  if (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/18099) 2>/dev/null; then READY=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || { wait "$TUNNEL_PID"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done
[ "$READY" = 1 ] || { echo 'SSH tunnel did not become ready' >&2; exit 1; }
HTTP_STATUS=$(/usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o "$TUNNEL_DIR/probe-body" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{}' http://127.0.0.1:18099/api/worker/claim)
[ "$HTTP_STATUS" = 401 ] || { echo 'isolated plane HTTP probe refused' >&2; exit 1; }
unset AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_PRIVATE_KEY_B64 AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_HOST_KEY
export AIVIDUP_REAL_PYTHON="$(command -v python3)"
export AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_STDOUT="$TUNNEL_DIR/cuda-rife-stdout.log"
export AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_STDERR="$TUNNEL_DIR/cuda-rife-stderr.log"
export AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_KEY="diagnostics-${AIVIDUP_BOOT_ID}-$(date +%s)-$$"
cat > "$TUNNEL_DIR/python3-log-wrapper" <<'PYWRAPPER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
if [ "${1:-}" = "/opt/aividup/cuda_runtime_preflight.py" ]; then
  set +e
  "$AIVIDUP_REAL_PYTHON" "$@" > "$AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_STDOUT" 2> "$AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_STDERR"
  preflight_rc=$?
  set -e
  { printf '%s\n' '=== CUDA/RIFE preflight stdout ==='; cat "$AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_STDOUT"; printf '%s\n' '=== CUDA/RIFE preflight stderr ==='; cat "$AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_STDERR"; } > "$TUNNEL_DIR/diagnostics.log"
  if ! /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 15 -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $AIVIDUP_WORKER_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' --data-binary @"$TUNNEL_DIR/diagnostics.log" "http://127.0.0.1:18099/api/worker/sink/$AIVIDUP_DIAGNOSTIC_KEY" >/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: preflight diagnostics could not be persisted' >&2
    exit 74
  fi
  exit "$preflight_rc"
fi
exec "$AIVIDUP_REAL_PYTHON" "$@"
PYWRAPPER
chmod 0700 "$TUNNEL_DIR/python3-log-wrapper"
export PYTHON="$TUNNEL_DIR/python3-log-wrapper"
python3 /opt/aividup/runpod_checkpoint_bootstrap.py &
WORKER_PID=$!
wait "$WORKER_PID"
